newsitem.title: USA: TransTexas Gas well shows 223 feet of pay.
newsitem.headline: TransTexas Gas well shows 223 feet of pay.

text.p: TransTexas Gas Corp said on Tuesday that the indicated 223 feet net pay in the Palmyra No. 9 well was the largest it had seen to date in the prolific Bob West North field of Zapata County, South Texas.
The Palmyra No. 9, which is 3.4 miles south of its Esperanza No. 1 well, was drilled to a measured depth of 11,900 feet and is expected to be completed November 1, 1996, TransTexas said.

TransTexas said the Salinas A-1, Salinas A-2, Palmyra No. 6 and Palmyra No. 9 wells confirm the presence of another shallower natural gas reservoir related to a separate structure within the Bob West North field.
The company expects this additional structure will provide further potential for proved reserves and production, it said.
The company has five rigs drilling development wells in Bob West North that it expects will allow it to add substantial incremental production, the company said.
